results.snippet: Potassium is a chemical element; it has symbol K.Potassium is chemically very similar to sodium, the previous element in group 1 of the periodic table. They have a similar first ionization energy, which allows for each atom to give up its sole outer electron.

results.title: Potassium - New World Encyclopedia
results.snippet: Potassium (chemical symbol K, atomic number 19) is a member of a group of chemical elements known as alkali metals. It is a soft metal and is silvery white when freshly cut, but it tarnishes rapidly on exposure to air.
